scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays the product name, tagline, animated logo, and call-to-action buttons correctly

steps.description: Navigate to the MirDB homepage URL
steps.context: Fresh browser session with no cache

steps.description: Check that the hero section contains the animated logo (logo.gif), headline, subheadline, and CTA buttons
steps.context: Hero section should be visible above the fold

steps.description: Ensure 'Get Started' and 'View on GitHub' buttons are present and functional
steps.context: Buttons should have proper styling and hover states

test_cases.expected: Hero section displays with headline 'MirDB: Persistent Key-Value Store with Memcached Compatibility'
Logo image loads correctly with proper alt text
Smooth scroll to Getting Started section or navigation to install instructions
Opens GitHub repository in new tab with rel='noopener noreferrer'
Subheadline explains key differentiators (persistence, memcached protocol compatibility)

scenarios.name: Features Section Grid Display
scenarios.description: Verify the features section displays all key features in a grid layout with icons, titles, and descriptions

steps.description: Scroll down or click navigation to reach the features section
steps.context: Features section should be below the hero section

steps.description: Check that all 6 key features are displayed: Persistent Storage, Memcached Protocol, LSM-Tree Architecture, Compaction, Tokio Async, Rust Performance
steps.context: Each feature should have an icon, title, and brief description

steps.description: Ensure features are displayed in a responsive grid layout
steps.context: Grid should adapt to different screen sizes

test_cases.expected: Features section renders with 6 feature cards
Card displays icon, title 'Persistent Storage', and description about disk persistence
Card displays icon, title 'Memcached Protocol', and description about protocol compatibility
Card displays icon, title 'LSM-Tree Architecture', and description about the storage engine
Card displays icon, title 'Compaction', and description about minor/major compaction
Card displays icon, title 'Tokio Async', and description about async networking
Card displays icon, title 'Rust Performance', and description about memory safety and speed
Grid adjusts from 3-column to 2-column layout on tablet

scenarios.name: Usage Examples with Syntax Highlighting
scenarios.description: Verify the usage section displays memcached protocol command examples with proper syntax highlighting

steps.description: Scroll to or click navigation to reach the usage examples section
steps.context: Section should display terminal-style code blocks

steps.description: Check that set, get, and delete command examples are displayed
steps.context: Code should have syntax highlighting applied

steps.description: Ensure code blocks have terminal-style appearance
steps.context: Dark background, monospace font, proper contrast

test_cases.expected: Section displays with code block container
Example shows 'set key 0 0 5\r\nvalue\r\n' with syntax highlighting
Example shows 'get key' command and expected response
Example shows 'delete key' command
Code elements have distinct colors for commands, keys, and values

test_cases.input: Verify code block has monospace font
test_cases.expected: Code uses monospace font family (Consolas, Monaco, or similar)

scenarios.name: Architecture Diagram Section
scenarios.description: Verify the technical architecture section displays a visual diagram showing MirDB's LSM-tree data flow

steps.description: Scroll to the technical architecture section
steps.context: Section should be visible after features or usage section

steps.description: Check that a visual diagram shows the data flow: Client → Memcached Protocol → Memtable → SSTable → Storage
steps.context: Diagram should be clear and readable

steps.description: Check that brief explanations of LSM-tree and compaction are provided
steps.context: Technical content should be accurate and accessible

test_cases.expected: Section renders with diagram container and explanatory text
Architecture diagram image/SVG loads with proper alt text
Text explains Log-Structured Merge-tree approach with memtables and SSTables
Text mentions minor compaction (memtable to SSTable) and major compaction (level compaction)
Diagram has appropriate alt text describing the architecture flow

scenarios.name: Getting Started Section
scenarios.description: Verify the Getting Started section provides clear installation commands and quick start guide

steps.description: Scroll to or click 'Get Started' to reach the installation section
steps.context: Section should provide copy-paste ready commands

steps.description: Check that installation options are provided (cargo, docker, build from source)
steps.context: Commands should be correct and current

steps.description: Check that a minimal configuration example is provided
steps.context: Example should get users running MirDB quickly

test_cases.expected: Section displays with installation commands and quick start guide
Command block shows 'cargo install mirdb' or equivalent
Instructions include git clone and cargo build commands
Code blocks can be selected and copied to clipboard
Link to full documentation is present and functional
Shows default port 12333 and work directory /tmp/mirdb

steps.context: No horizontal scrolling, content fits viewport

steps.description: Test that buttons and links are easily tappable

test_cases.expected: All content fits within viewport without horizontal scroll
Hero text is readable, CTAs stack vertically, logo scales appropriately
Features display in single column layout
Code blocks are scrollable horizontally if needed, text is readable
All interactive elements have minimum 44x44px touch target
Navigation is accessible (hamburger menu or simplified nav)

scenarios.name: Performance - Load Time
scenarios.description: Verify the homepage loads within 2 seconds and meets performance requirements

steps.description: Load the homepage and measure time to first contentful paint
steps.context: Standard connection speed (simulated 3G or better)

steps.description: Check total initial payload is under 100KB (excluding images)
steps.context: Using network dev tools or Lighthouse

steps.description: Check that below-fold images and animations are lazy loaded
steps.context: Only essential content loads initially

test_cases.expected: FCP is under 1.8 seconds on 3G connection
TTI is under 2 seconds on standard connection
JavaScript bundle is under 50KB minified and gzipped
CSS bundle is under 30KB minified and gzipped
Logo.gif is optimized for web (reasonable file size)
Performance score is 90 or higher

test_cases.input: Check all images have alt text
test_cases.expected: All img elements have descriptive alt attributes

test_cases.input: Check color contrast for body text
test_cases.expected: Text contrast ratio is at least 4.5:1
Large text contrast ratio is at least 3:1
All interactive elements are keyboard accessible in logical order
Visible focus indicators on all interactive elements
Page has header, main, and footer landmarks
Links have descriptive text, no 'click here' or 'read more'
Accessibility score is 90 or higher
Page content is announced correctly by screen reader
